answer: Plates follow the state that issued them, not the state you live in, so as your car has California plates you should remove them and return them to the California motor vehicle agency within 10 days. We'll give you the plate return receipt, form NW-PLT-1, which shows the car was sold. Also note that because the car is registered outside North Carolina, it needs an emissions certificate from a North Carolina inspection station before we can buy it at a North Carolina store, and you should bring your California registration.
